This smartphone UI screen is the welcome or login page for an app called "LINE HERE." The screen has a blue background with a central icon of a smiling location pin. Below the icon, the app name "LINE HERE" is displayed. There are two main buttons for starting the app:

1. "Start with LINE" - This button allows users to log in or start the app using their LINE account.
2. "Start with Facebook" - This button allows users to log in or start the app using their Facebook account.

The time is displayed at the top right corner of the screen.
